NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is checked only when you punch in or out, to confirm you are at the clinic.
NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera scans the clinic code on the iPad when you punch in or out.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Your shifts are added to a Clinic Workforce calendar, with the clinic's address, only if you turn this on in Setup.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Your shifts are added to a Clinic Workforce calendar, with the clinic's address, only if you turn this on in Setup.
